explanation:
Template class specialization in C++ allows developers to define custom implementations of a class template for specific types or conditions. This feature enables optimized or tailored behavior when the generic template does not suffice, enhancing flexibility and efficiency in generic programming. It is particularly useful in the context of the Standard Template Library (STL) and modern C++ idioms, where generic containers and algorithms benefit from specialized behavior for certain data types.

Template class specialization in C++ allows developers to define custom implementations of a class template for specific types. This feature is used to optimize or modify behavior when the generic template does not suffice, enabling more efficient or tailored code for particular data types while maintaining generic code for others. It is essential in generic programming to handle special cases without sacrificing code reusability.
